## TOD Pipeline

Calibrate radio-telescope scans and reconstruct sky brightness.

Use three development scans to build a cleaning and calibration script. It must process eleven held-out scans and bin an eight-band sky map, separating instrument drift, atmosphere and sidelobe contamination.

## Published conditions

No hints.

The task is counted once; hint variants are not separate problems. This entry records the actual current result-catalog family. Full runnable task assets are not provided by the public website.
